stories.title: Schottenheimer owned up to Rio mistakes in meeting with Cowboys players
stories.summary: Cowboys coach Brian Schottenheimer took accountability in the locker room for last Sunday's late-game loss to the Ravens.

stories.title: Brewers escape as Padres' potential go-ahead HR hits roof, falls for out
stories.summary: The Brewers eked out a Game 1 NLDS win after the American Family Field roof impeded what the Padres thought was going to be a go-ahead home run in the ninth inning.

stories.title: Sources: LaPorta, Lions break off contract talks after negotiations stall
stories.summary: The Lions and star tight end Sam LaPorta have broken off contract talks, sources told NFL Network, after attempting to work out a long-term deal for the first few weeks of the season.

stories.title: Sources: Mayfield out 3-6 weeks, depending on when QB can grip football
stories.summary: Baker Mayfield is expected to miss anywhere from three to six weeks, sources told ESPN, depending on how quickly the Buccaneers quarterback can grip the football.

stories.title: Smith to Heisman voters after record day: 'I'm the best player in the country'
stories.summary: Jeremiah Smith likely cemented himself as the Heisman front-runner with another monster performance in which he also became Ohio State's career receptions and touchdown receptions leader during Saturday's 31-14 win over Iowa.
